test_case_1_standard.description: Standard business request for an 8-week AI customer support chatbot project plan

payload.request: Create a project plan for launching an AI-powered customer support chatbot for a 50-person e-commerce company within 8 weeks. Include phases, milestones, risks, owners, and success metrics.

test_case_2_complex.description: Complex, ambiguous request with limited budget, no vendor chosen, requiring explicit assumptions and pilot comparison

payload.request: Prepare a proposal for improving our customer support. We have a small team, a limited budget, and want to use AI, but we have not chosen a vendor or defined success metrics. Make reasonable assumptions, compare a lightweight pilot with a full rollout, identify risks, and recommend next steps without inventing exact costs.
